trends.name: Iran War Oil Supply Crisis
trends.summary: Strait of Hormuz closure threatens $150–$200 oil spike if prolonged; Trump administration prioritizing quick military resolution over shipping reopening. Real-time reports of Iranian infrastructure strikes (desalination plants, military checkpoints) and analyst warnings of sustained supply disruption affecting global markets.

trends.name: US Gas Prices Hit $4/Gallon
trends.summary: Gasoline surged above $4.00 per gallon for first time since 2022, driven by Iran war supply disruptions and Hormuz shipping concerns. Marks significant inflation pressure on consumers and reverses recent energy price declines.

trends.name: Gold Bull Run Ending
trends.summary: Gold tracking worst month since 2008 amid Iran war escalation and potential peace resolution. UBS strategist signals bull run may be finishing as geopolitical risk premium unwinds and real yields stabilize.

trends.name: European Inflation Surge
trends.summary: Eurozone inflation hits 2.5% in March, breaching ECB target as energy costs spike from Iran conflict. French inflation accelerating while economy stalls—stagflation risk rising. Bank of Japan also moving forward with April hike despite slower Tokyo inflation.

trends.name: Software Outperformance vs Semiconductors
trends.summary: Software stocks outperformed semiconductors by 500bps today—rare divergence signaling sector rotation away from AI hardware concentration. Market reassessing AI infrastructure thesis as software valuations attract capital on recession concerns.

trends.name: Global Recession Fears in 2026
trends.summary: Wall Street's 2026 optimism collapsing into recession defense mode; SPY down 7.1% YTD while bonds flat, signaling risk-off positioning. Geopolitical escalation, inflation resurge, and energy shock destroying growth narrative.

trends.name: Military & Defense Sector Surge
trends.summary: Autonomous ship startup Saronic raises $1.75B for US military modernization; European defense startups pivoting to Middle East commercial deals. Hegseth reportedly targeting defense fund investments pre-war. Iran conflict accelerating defense capex cycle.

trends.name: Asia AI Infrastructure Build-Out
trends.summary: Nebius planning one of Europe's largest AI factories; Indian Airtel raises $1B from Carlyle for data center expansion. Asia-Pacific racing to build compute capacity amid US supply chain concerns and global AI infrastructure race.

trends.name: China Commodity Supply Chain Grip
trends.summary: Iran's aluminum producer attacks creating shockwaves; niche commodity prices surging as China maintains supply chain chokehold. Geopolitical conflict exposing fragile dependencies on critical materials, raising inflation and onshoring risks.

trends.name: Yen Weakens Amid BOJ Tightening
trends.summary: BoJ Yen-Index falling to 73.68 despite April rate hike decision, reflecting currency weakness even as central bank tightens. BOJ continuing hawkish pivot despite deflationary pressures, signaling commitment to normalize policy.

trends.name: Defense Contractors Underperformance
trends.summary: Defense contractors have underperformed since Iran war began despite geopolitical premium; market skeptical of conflict duration and profitability. Hegseth's reported broker attempts to buy defense fund signal insider view of valuation disconnects.

trends.name: High-Yield REITs & Dividend Plays
trends.summary: One Liberty Properties receiving rating upgrade for high-yield inflection amid market rotation to income. Flight to safety driving demand for dividend-yielding assets as recession fears and rate uncertainty persist.
